header: Six openings, and what each of them actually involves
lead: Field work in this district means weather, mud and a van. Everything below is permanent unless it says otherwise, and every posting states the collective-agreement minimum along with what we actually pay.
note: Nothing here that fits you? Write to Christoph Waldner anyway. Two of the last five people we hired applied when we had nothing advertised.
